title: Pure Toy
summary: The 2024 Toy engine paired with classic Toy monsters, Diabell, Queen of the White Forest, and generic staples. Toy Box Sets Toy monsters as Spells and destroys them to swarm Level 4 LIGHT bodies for Rank 4, Link, and Synchro plays.

summary.title: Starters
points: Toy Box Sets up to 2 monsters with 'Toy' in their effects that can Set themselves as Spells (Toy Soldier, Toy Tank, or Toy Magician) from your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY into your Spell & Trap Zone, and can destroy up to 2 Set cards in your Spell & Trap Zone to trigger them.

Toy Soldier can be Set in your Spell & Trap Zone as a Spell; when sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY, it Special Summons itself, and when Normal or Special Summoned, it searches Toy Box (or any Level 4 LIGHT monster if you already control Toy Box).

summary.title: Opening: Toy Box
steps: Activate Toy Box, use its effect to Set Toy Soldier and Toy Tank from the Deck in your Spell & Trap Zone, then use Toy Box's other effect (or send them as cost) to send those Set cards to the GY.
Toy Soldier and Toy Tank both trigger in the GY to Special Summon themselves, and Toy Soldier's on-summon effect searches a Level 4 LIGHT monster (Toy Soldier, Toy Tank, or Toy Magician).

Tribute Toy Tank on the field to Special Summon the searched Level 4 LIGHT monster from your hand (or revive Toy Soldier from the GY if you control Toy Box), putting multiple Level 4 bodies on the field without using your Normal Summon.

summary.title: Toy Tank & Classic Toys
summary.text: Toy Tank Special Summons itself when sent from the Spell & Trap Zone to the GY, then Tributes itself from the Monster Zone to Special Summon any Level 6 or lower monster from your hand—or from your GY (except Toy Tank) if you control Toy Box. Toy Magician can also be Set directly from the Deck by Toy Box, revives itself in the End Phase when destroyed while Set, and destroys Spells/Traps when Flip Summoned. Toy Knight Special Summons itself when the opponent controls more monsters and pulls a second Toy Knight from the hand.

summary.title: Control & Payoff
points: Once per turn when an opponent's monster declares an attack, Toy Box sends 1 face-down card you control (such as a Set Toy Soldier, Toy Tank, or The Black Goat Laughs) to the GY to destroy that attacking monster while triggering the sent Toy's Special Summon.

The Black Goat Laughs declares 1 Monster Card name to prevent either player from Special Summoning monsters with that original name on the field, or banishes itself from the GY to stop neither player from activating the effects of monsters on the field with that declared name.
Diabell, Queen of the White Forest (accessible with a handtrap Tuner and a Level 4 or 5 body) recycles Spells/Traps from the GY and sends a Spell/Trap to the GY as a Quick Effect.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: The page's full White Forest and Centur-Ion hybrid packages are omitted so the list focuses on the pure Toy cards.
